AdminExtraResponse.description:
An extra, for agents: inactive ones (gone from the DÉTOUR export) and hidden ones too.
hidden is the only field an agent changes; DÉTOUR owns the rest.
AdminExtraResponse.title: AdminExtraResponse

AgentPlan.description:
The plan as the assigned agent sees it. Prices, partners, running total and budget.
total counts priced items and priced extras; ready_to_quote is false while a kept item or
an on_quote extra has no price, or a supplement that needs a quantity check is not
confirmed.
AgentPlan.title: AgentPlan

AgentPlanExtra.description:
An extra the client chose. price_eur: the supplement, or what the agent set; null for
an included extra and for an on_quote extra not priced yet. needs_quantity_check: a
supplement per person, night or day; its amount is counted once, so the agent checks the
quantity and confirms it by setting its price, even the same one (confirmed).
AgentPlanExtra.title: AgentPlanExtra

AgentPlanItem.description: One day for the assigned agent: negotiated price, and the partner to call.
AgentPlanItem.title: AgentPlanItem

AnswerPanelRequest.description: The panel answers. Every tag must come from the panel shown; no tags is allowed.
AnswerPanelRequest.title: AnswerPanelRequest

DestinationResponse.description: A place Novoya can plan a trip, from listed partner offers.
DestinationResponse.title: DestinationResponse

ErrorResponse.description: Body of every error raised by a business rule.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

ExtraResponse.description: An option a client can add to a plan. supplement_eur only for a supplement.
ExtraResponse.title: ExtraResponse

OfferDetailResponse.description:
A listed offer for its page. The price is indicative, per person (ADR 0014): the agent
negotiates the price of the trip and the quote has it. Never the partner.
OfferDetailResponse.title: OfferDetailResponse

OfferResponse.description: An offer, for agents. hidden: the agent's switch in Novoya, kept by the import.
OfferResponse.title: OfferResponse

PanelOut.description: The preference panel (ARCHITECTURE.md section 3). Render it with generic components.
PanelOut.title: PanelOut

PartnerResponse.description:
A partner. imported: it comes from DÉTOUR, which owns everything but hidden (its offers
too, but for featured and hidden): a PATCH of anything else is a 409 imported_row.
PartnerResponse.title: PartnerResponse

Plan.description: The plan day by day. Never a price: the quote has it. Never a partner name.
Plan.title: Plan

PlanResponse.description:
The proposed plan, day by day. No price until it is quoted and no partner name.
based_on_preferences is false when the client picked no tag.
PlanResponse.title: PlanResponse

QueueEntry.description: A plan waiting for a quote. Wish text, place, dates, travellers and budget. No prices.
QueueEntry.title: QueueEntry

Quote.description:
A sent quote. total is in currency (always EUR); the PDF is at GET /quotes/{id}/pdf.
email_sent is false when the client's email did not go out: POST
/agent/quotes/{id}/email sends it again.
Quote.title: Quote

QuoteDetail.description:
A quote and where it stands: open, expired once the validity date has passed, or the
client's answer (accepted, rejected). Unlike the quote just sent, it has no email_sent:
that only matters when it is sent.
QuoteDetail.title: QuoteDetail

QuoteStatus.description: Where a quote stands: open until the client answers or its validity ends.
QuoteStatus.title: QuoteStatus

RequestQuoteRequest.description: The extras the client adds to the plan. Without a body, none.
RequestQuoteRequest.title: RequestQuoteRequest

ReviewResponse.description: A published review. The author is "First name I." or "Voyageur anonyme", as given.
ReviewResponse.title: ReviewResponse

SelectedTagIn.description: A tag of the panel, by the ids it was shown with.
SelectedTagIn.title: SelectedTagIn

SendQuoteRequest.description: The quote's language, chosen by the agent. Without it, the client's language.
SendQuoteRequest.title: SendQuoteRequest

SetPlanExtraRequest.description: The price in EUR of an on_quote extra, or an adjusted supplement.
SetPlanExtraRequest.title: SetPlanExtraRequest

SetPlanItemRequest.description: Set a negotiated price in EUR, or set removed. True drops the item, false puts it back.
SetPlanItemRequest.title: SetPlanItemRequest

UpdateExtraRequest.description: true hides the extra from clients, false shows it again. The import never changes it.
UpdateExtraRequest.title: UpdateExtraRequest

UpdateOfferRequest.description:
Absent fields are unchanged, and so is null, except for price_eur and price_unit
(cleared together) and opening_months (cleared to none). An offer of an imported partner
only accepts featured and hidden: any other change is a 409 imported_row.
UpdateOfferRequest.title: UpdateOfferRequest

UpdatePartnerRequest.description:
Absent or null fields are unchanged. hidden hides the partner and its offers in Novoya;
the DÉTOUR import never changes it. An imported partner only accepts hidden.
UpdatePartnerRequest.title: UpdatePartnerRequest

UserDetailResponse.description: One user for an admin: with their sign-in methods.
UserDetailResponse.title: UserDetailResponse

UserResponse.description: A user as an admin sees them.
UserResponse.title: UserResponse

WishResponse.description:
panel_shown: show the panel. not_covered: we don't go there, offer the suggestions.
draft: the text names no place, ask where, with the suggestions as choices.
WishResponse.title: WishResponse

get.description: All extras, inactive and hidden ones too. Agents only.

patch.description:
Hide an extra from clients, or show it again. Extras come from DÉTOUR, which owns the
rest: the import never changes hidden. Agents only.

get.description:
All offers, including inactive ones. With partner_id, only that partner's offers (an
unknown partner gives an empty list). Agents only.

post.description:
Add an offer for an existing partner made in Novoya. A partner imported from DÉTOUR gets
its offers from DÉTOUR: 409 imported_row. Agents only.

patch.description:
Change an offer. null clears the price with its unit, or the opening months. An offer of
a partner imported from DÉTOUR only changes featured and hidden: anything else is 409
imported_row. Agents only.

get.description: All partners, including inactive ones. Agents only.

patch.description:
Change a partner. Deactivating or hiding it hides its offers from search. A partner
imported from DÉTOUR only changes hidden: anything else is 409 imported_row. Agents only.

get.description: The users, newest first. Admin only.

parameters.description: Part of an email or name
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Part of an email or name
schema.title: Q

patch.description: Give a user another role. Admin only, never on their own account. The change is logged.

Disable or enable a user's account. Admin only, never on their own account (409) nor
on another admin's (403). Disabling ends the user's sessions; who and when are kept.

get.description:
Plans waiting for a quote, oldest first. Wish text, destination, dates, travellers, budget.
Never a price and never a partner name: take the plan to see those.

The plan as the assigned agent sees it: prices, partners to call, total vs budget.
403 if another agent took it.

patch.description:
Set the price in EUR of an on_quote extra, or adjust a supplement. Only the assigned
agent. 404 if the extra is not on the plan. 409 if the plan is no longer negotiating.

Set the negotiated price in EUR, or set removed (true drops, false puts back).
Only the assigned agent. 409 if the plan is no longer negotiating.

post.description:
Send the quote: the total of the priced items and extras, valid 7 days, rendered as a
PDF in the language the agent chose (en or fr; the client's language without a body).
The plan becomes quoted and the client gets an email that leads to the quote; email_sent
is false if it did not go out (the quote is saved anyway). Only the assigned agent (403).
409 if the plan is not negotiating (a second click too). 422 plan_not_ready while a kept
item or an on_quote extra has no price, or a supplement is not confirmed.
Assign this requested plan to me and move it to negotiating. 409 if it is already taken.

Send the client's "your quote is ready" email again. Only the agent who sent the quote,
or an admin (403). At most 3 times an hour per quote: 429 too_many_requests after that,
with Retry-After. 503 email_not_sent if the email server did not take it.
Confirm the email address with the token from the verification link.
Send a new verification link, if the account exists and is not verified yet.
Sign in with email and password. Sets the session cookie.
Close the current session. Works even if it already expired.
Close every session of the signed-in user, on every device.
Change the password of the signed-in user. Their other sessions are closed.
Send a reset link, if the account exists. The answer is the same either way.
Set a new password with the token from the reset link. Every session is closed.
Create a client account. A verification link is sent by email.

get.description:
Where the provider sends the browser back. Creates, links or loads the account, sets
the session cookie and goes to the page asked at the start.

302.description: To the provider or the web app; on failure to /login?error=<code>

get.description:
Start signing in with the provider (google). Only openid, email and profile are asked.
Sets a 10-minute state cookie: the callback must come back to this browser.

parameters.description: A page of the web app, e.g. /wishes/new
parameters.name: redirect_to

schema.description: A page of the web app, e.g. /wishes/new
schema.title: Redirect To

302.description: To the provider or the web app; on failure to /login?error=<code>

get.description: Countries and cities with at least one listed offer. Read from the database each time.
Options a client can add when asking for a quote. Active ones that no agent hid.

delete.description:
Delete my account and everything Novoya stored about me: wishes, plans and quotes with
their PDF (GDPR). Signs me out. Clients only: 403 staff_account for an agent or an admin,
whose plans and quotes must keep pointing to them.

get.description: The signed-in user, with their role. The web app shows its menus from the role.

patch.description: Change the signed-in user's language (en or fr). Answers like GET /me.

get.description:
A listed offer: indicative price per person, opening months and terms. Never the partner.
The agent still negotiates the trip's price. 404 if it is unknown or not listed.

The plan day by day. Never a price: the quote has it. Never the partners' names.
404 if it is missing or not the caller's, so the id stays hidden.

post.description:
Ask an agent to price this plan, with optional extras. proposed becomes requested.
Never a price here. 404 if it is missing or not the caller's. 409 if it is not proposed
(a second click too). 422 if an extra is unknown or no longer offered.

get.description:
The quote and where it stands (open, expired after its validity date, accepted or
rejected), for its client or staff (agents, admins). 404 for anyone else, so the id
stays hidden.

The quote as a PDF, for its client or an agent. 404 for anyone else, so the id stays
hidden.

Published reviews, newest first, at most 100. Public: only reviews the travellers agreed
to publish, under "First name I." or "Voyageur anonyme". Filter by country and city.

post.description:
Send the trip the client wants, in their words. Returns the panel when we cover the
destination, suggestions when we don't, and asks where when the text names no place.

Save the tags the client picked, their budget in EUR, travellers and dates, and return
the proposed plan built from partner offers. 404 if the wish is not theirs; 409 if it is
already answered, shows no panel or is being answered by another request; 422 for a tag
the panel did not show, and 422 no_offer_fits when no offer fits the travellers and
dates.
